summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing integration with Spark, including the removal of Spark 3.4 support. Proposals for fine-grained access policies and a new FileRef type for unstructured data management are also being explored, alongside optimizations for Parquet read paths and handling of statistics files.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration updates
Proposal for fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable
Discussion on FileRef type for unstructured objects
Optimizing Parquet read path by reducing S3 GET requests
